subject: DAG structural reranking: boost RAG hits with high-scoring graph neighbors
description: In /search in daemon.js, after the hybrid scoring pass, add a structural rerank step: for each RAG result, look up its immediate graph neighbors (context/blocking/decision edges), find the max score among neighbors already in the scored set, and apply a small boost (0.1 × neighbor_max_score).
